description: This file defines extension methods for the IEntity interface, providing functionality to extract, check, modify, and create properties and aspects associated with IEntity instances, utilizing JSON serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: EntityExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for IEntity to facilitate property extraction, checking, modification, and aspect management.

methods.name: As
methods.description: Extracts a property of type T from an IEntity, using the type name as the property key.

methods.name: As
methods.description: Extracts a named property of type T from an IEntity.

methods.name: Has
methods.description: Checks if an IEntity has a property of type T.

methods.name: Has
methods.description: Checks if an IEntity has a property with the specified name.

methods.name: Put
methods.description: Adds or updates a property of type T in an IEntity.

methods.name: TryGet
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a property of type T from an IEntity.

methods.name: TryGet
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a named property of type T from an IEntity.

methods.name: Put
methods.description: Adds or updates a property with a specified name and value in an IEntity.

methods.name: Alter
methods.description: Modifies or creates an aspect of type TAspect in an IEntity.

methods.name: Alter
methods.description: Modifies or creates a named aspect of type TAspect in an IEntity.
